records.quote: A small chance of distress or disgrace cannot, in our view, be offset by a large chance of extra returns.
records.attribution: Warren Buffett, Berkshire Hathaway shareholder letter, 1989
records.speaker: Warren Buffett

records.quote: When bills come due, only cash is legal tender.
records.attribution: Warren Buffett, Berkshire Hathaway shareholder letter, 2014
records.speaker: Warren Buffett

records.quote: In general, survival is the only road to riches.
records.attribution: Peter L. Bernstein, MONEY Magazine interview, Oct 11, 2004
records.speaker: Peter L. Bernstein

records.quote: Time is the friend of the wonderful business, the enemy of the mediocre.
records.attribution: Warren Buffett, Berkshire Hathaway shareholder letter, 1989
records.speaker: Warren Buffett

records.quote: And, finally, even when Berkshire was getting much better opportunities than most others, Buffett often displayed almost inhuman patience and seldom bought.
records.attribution: Charlie Munger, "Vice Chairman's Thoughts," Berkshire Hathaway 2014 letter
records.speaker: Charlie Munger

records.quote: Time is on your side in the stock market.
records.attribution: Peter Lynch, PBS *Frontline*, "Betting on the Market"
records.speaker: Peter Lynch

records.quote: It never had the equivalent of a 'department of acquisitions' under pressure to buy.
records.attribution: Charlie Munger, "Vice Chairman's Thoughts," Berkshire Hathaway 2014 letter
records.speaker: Charlie Munger

records.quote: Overall, however, we've done better by avoiding dragons than by slaying them.
records.attribution: Warren Buffett, Berkshire Hathaway shareholder letter, 1989
records.speaker: Warren Buffett

records.quote: Principles are ways of successfully dealing with reality to get what you want out of life.
records.attribution: Ray Dalio, Principles (principles.com)
records.speaker: Ray Dalio

records.quote: An investor who has all the answers doesn't even understand all the questions
records.attribution: Sir John Templeton, "16 Rules for Investment Success," 1993 (Franklin Templeton / John Templeton Foundation)
records.speaker: Sir John Templeton
records.source: "16 Rules for Investment Success" (Franklin Templeton / John Templeton Foundation)

records.quote: I've been wrong before. I'll be wrong again on things.
records.attribution: Stanley Druckenmiller, The Economic Club of New York, May 12, 2020
records.speaker: Stanley Druckenmiller
records.source: The Economic Club of New York transcript

records.quote: That's what diversification is for. It's an explicit recognition of ignorance.
records.attribution: Peter L. Bernstein, MONEY Magazine interview, Oct 11, 2004
records.speaker: Peter L. Bernstein

records.quote: I deal in facts, not forecasting the future.
records.attribution: Peter Lynch, PBS *Frontline*, "Betting on the Market"
records.speaker: Peter Lynch

records.quote: And it never relied on advice from 'helpers' sure to be prejudiced in favor of transactions.
records.attribution: Charlie Munger, "Vice Chairman's Thoughts," Berkshire Hathaway 2014 letter
records.speaker: Charlie Munger

records.quote: we simply attempt to be fearful when others are greedy and to be greedy only when others are fearful
records.attribution: Warren Buffett, Berkshire Hathaway shareholder letter, 1986
records.speaker: Warren Buffett
records.note: Reproduced in the letter's own wording. The widely circulated imperative form is a paraphrase and is not used here.

records.quote: Broad diversification, low cost, minimal portfolio turnover, and tax-efficiency conquer all.
records.attribution: John C. Bogle, "Success In Investment Management: What Can We Learn From Indexing?", Oct 26, 2000
records.speaker: John C. Bogle
records.source: "Success In Investment Management: What Can We Learn From Indexing?", Investment Analysts Society of Chicago

records.quote: When you invest, it's not your wealth today, but it's your future that you're really managing.
records.attribution: Peter L. Bernstein, MONEY Magazine interview, Oct 11, 2004
records.speaker: Peter L. Bernstein

records.quote: The only way to avoid mistakes is not to invest—which is the biggest mistake of all.
records.attribution: Sir John Templeton, "16 Rules for Investment Success," 1993
records.speaker: Sir John Templeton
records.source: "16 Rules for Investment Success" (Franklin Templeton / John Templeton Foundation)

records.quote: You have to understand that being wrong is part of the process.
records.attribution: Peter L. Bernstein, MONEY Magazine interview, Oct 11, 2004
records.speaker: Peter L. Bernstein

records.quote: Go to the pain rather than avoid it.
records.attribution: Ray Dalio, Principles (principles.com)
records.speaker: Ray Dalio
